senses.definition: (of events) planned or scheduled
examples: the picnic is on, rain or shine
we have nothing on for Friday night

senses.definition: in operation or operational
examples: the switch is in the on position

senses.definition: in a state required for something to function or be effective
indicates continuity or persistence or concentration
with a forward motion
examples: we drove along admiring the view
the horse trotted along at a steady pace
the circus traveled on to the next city

senses.definition: as soon as
examples: once we are home, we can rest

senses.definition: at a previous time
examples: at one time he loved her

senses.definition: on one occasion
(informal) very; used informally as an intensifier
being a single entity made by combining separate components
examples: three chemicals combining into one solution

senses.definition: eminent beyond or above comparison
examples: she's one girl in a million
the one and only Muhammad Ali
infamy unmatched in the Western world

senses.definition: having the indivisible character of a unit
indefinite in time or position
of the same kind or quality
used of a single unit or thing; not two or more
a single person or thing
examples: this is the one I ordered

senses.definition: the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
examples: he has the one but will need a two and three to go with it

senses.definition: an aromatic flavorful vegetable
bulbous plant having hollow leaves cultivated worldwide for its rounded edible bulb
the bulb of an onion plant
being in progress now
connected to a computer network or accessible by computer
on a regular route of a railroad or bus or airline system
through a computer or a computer network
examples: People were encouraged to submit their designs online at www.flag.govt.nz and suggest what the flag should mean on www.standfor.co.nz.
Images of the boy wearing a NASA T-shirt and handcuffed by the police were quickly posted and reposted online.
They should be available at your local home improvement store or online.

senses.definition: being the only one; single and isolated from others
examples: the lone doctor in the entire county
a solitary speck in the sky

senses.definition: exclusive of anyone or anything else
examples: I'll have this car and this car only

senses.definition: and nothing more
examples: it is simply a matter of time
hopes that last but a moment

senses.definition: as recently as
examples: I spoke to him only an hour ago

senses.definition: except that
examples: It was the same story; only this time she came out better

senses.definition: in the final outcome
examples: These news will only make you more upset

senses.definition: with nevertheless the final result
examples: He arrived only to find his wife dead
We won only to lose again in the next round

senses.definition: without any others being included or involved
examples: a school devoted entirely to the needs of problem children
he works for Mr. Smith exclusively
the burden of proof rests on the prosecution alone
a privilege granted only to him

senses.definition: situated or taking place on the area of a stage visible to the audience
on the stage
examples: it was time for her to go onstage
